noncomputable def VTask.findGreatest (P : ℕ → Prop) (hP : DecidablePred P) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  let rec go (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
    if hP i then
      if i = n then i else go (i + 1)
    else
      if i > 0 then go (i - 1) else 0
  go n
